# Avatar conversion and natural idle

Author: もち山金魚 / MOCHIYAMA.

Unchanged source stand + breath; source additive breath also layers onto authored static poses. Never double breath in neutral Idle or sleep clips.

Original eye_close morph with App-authored irregular blink timing; no verified source automatic schedule claimed.

Manual expressions and sleep transitions suppress automatic blinking. Mouth visemes remain separate.

App-authored low-amplitude horizontal breeze, independent hair/cloth budgets, source chains and collision spheres; no upward gusts or direct bone sine animation.

Original facial, hand, ear, tail and appearance options are retained. No SDK code or default VRChat motions are included. Source archives and samples remain unchanged. The standalone spring approximation is not the VRChat PhysBone solver.
